name: Magnetized accretion disk
blurb: A disk around one point mass threaded by weak field loops: the magnetorotational instability winds them up and turns the flow turbulent within a few orbits, and the turbulence carries gas inward. One orbit at r = 1 is t = 2π.

featured.label: Plasma beta at the midplane
featured.tip: Ratio of the gas pressure to the magnetic pressure B^2 / 2 at the midplane where two loops meet (the field is strongest there): the larger, the weaker the field, and the shorter the wavelength the MRI grows at (it scales as beta^-1/2, and needs some 8 cells to grow at the right rate). Changing it starts the run again

featured.label: Softening and sink radius
featured.tip: Radius within which the mass’s pull is softened and it takes in gas (at least two cells). The disk’s inner edge is at r = 0.75. Changes take effect without a restart
